fields.statement: At commit 05e811bf3: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'TestHandbackDeliver' -v passes (9 subtests, including the new 'a live session that said done on an earlier visit has its done mark cleared' and 'a failed hand-back leaves a live session's done mark in place'); go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api/... ok; gofmt -l internal/api empty. The happy subtest covers the acceptance as written: the done mark is cleared, the hook stays idle, message 0001.md is written ending with the handback text, rex send is called (typed), AgentStatus reports SaidDone false, then session.done gives a fresh mark (not Already) and AgentStatus reports SaidDone true. The failure subtest uses a step with no handback template: the error names step build, the done mark is kept, no message is written and there are no rex calls. Diff read against must_not: only Status.Done is cleared in messageSession (asked, hook, rex, started and prompted are untouched). messageSession's only caller is Handback's live branch; resumeSession, session done/message and internal/run are unchanged. The mark is cleared only after the messageable, sender and folder checks, so a template failure, which returns earlier in Handback, leaves the mark.
